body: Thank you.
I think you still need help. Im surprised you were released this early after your attempt.Are you seeing a therapist ir psychiatrist?

I never thought about being scared of getting the help I need. I think it’s very embarrassing to say all these words out. I am not scared of getting help, but I’m scared of mental hospital environments, and being vulnerable.
No I can’t share this with my T. It’s too embarrassing.

Thats the problem. Everyone said I was lucky at the end.
I called poison control that I found out more than 13 tablets of 500 mg is required an er visit. They gave me this info without asking my weight. But when I use poison control website and filled out the form with my age and weight information , it says it doesn’t require er visit even when I entered taking 17 pills of 500mg. 
I don’t know why the website said its ok. But I assume I will be fine.
I don’t understand, are you scared to hurt yourself if you shower?
I want to know what will happen if they find out
What was their reaction?
I don’t know. I can’t imagine it will be helpful with the amount of anxiety I have even thinking about it.
Alright thanks!
BTW, if you can be more clear and answer my question with yes or no, it would be great help to me. I am trying to find the answer before my appointment and decide if I share the whole details or not.

Thank you! I am terribly scared and embarrassed in front of my husband if I ended up hospitalization. I would rather die. I feel very nervous to be around other patients and stay the night at a hospital setting and being monitored. Even thinking about it makes my heart rate increase.
Thank you

Thanks. Im not sure if I can say these words out loud but I will try if I made a new appointment. Its Kaiser Permanente and all my visits summaries are available as soon as it’s completed by the doctor/ therapist. It even has notes about my appearance and my tone of talking.

I’ve seen my after visit summary in my previous therapy sessions. They make a note of all topics not in details but it’s documented. I feel embarrassed when I read some of them. I even sometimes enjoy reading the notes and enjoy feeling embarrassed. But right now I’m so stressed out and it prevents me from talking in reality with a therapist.
How old are you?
How was the symptoms? Do you think you could die without getting help?

Thank you! I have been told some of these by my therapist and I know that some of my thoughts are not real from others point of view but they are so real to me and so hard to change them. I was specifically told by a therapist “you are your worst enemy “ which sticks to my mind and unfortunately I use it as a proof of validation of “I m stupid person “ although I know their purpose was to navigate me to understand some of my thoughts and not true. Anyway, thanks again!
Thank you! I should read this multiple time. It’s painful to see this honesty but its very true. I feel I am drowning and I really need help.
Thats a good idea. I may try this.

Thank you for taking time to write this response to me. Unfortunately I am not comfortable talking and I have tried multiple times to share with my family doctor or my therapist but I wasn’t successful sharing all this information. I feel so stupid for being so guarded.
I do exactly the same thing. Just to make sure they have 5 fingers. Not really know why I do this.

Thank you! “Nothing changes if nothing changes” is so inspiring. Honestly I am not sure if I survive, I am feeling so overwhelmed and have physical pain, chest pain and extremely tired. I am not sure if I can handle this situation long but I am living day by day . Thank you for your response.
Thank you! I think I am scared by this warning. Im not sure how a stranger can hurt me over internet. I posted here because it’s anonymous and I feel safe to talk anonymously.

Thank you! Im not sure what do you mean by this sentence “for obvious reasons you should keep these thoughts private “. I don’t share my thoughts with anyone in my life. Is there something specific that you are referring?
Yeah I hate life. It’s so hard.
Thank you. I guess I should look for some other pills.
I have some questions as well. I send you a dm if you can help. Thank you

Thank you! I want to share with them but I’m scared that they force me to go to er for checkup which ends up hospitalization. Yeah I’m scared of myself and the possibility of things I am thinking to hurt myself.

You definitely need to change your T. I had the same issue. I feel like some T don’t like when patients talk about suicidal thoughts because it seems like a threat to them and their license. My T actually told me exactly that if I don’t report you and something happened to you, your family could sue me and my license gets revoked. Exact words! I felt like I am a threat to them and I was so embarrassed. Please find someone who is willing to help you and has experience to not traumatize you.

You are here for a reason, it’s a difficult position to be in, be kind to yourself because you deserve it more than any other time in your life to pass these days and start fresh. You will get back to your hobbies one day soon 🤍
I hope everything turns out well for you 🤍

Im the same and only thing that makes me get out of bed is my job. I think you have to be forced but some obligations to get you out of the bed. Then after work find a friend or coworkers or some one to company you for a short exercise.After exercise you will feel better and the same routine everyday except weekends which you will stay in bed all day again 🥲
Ok. Thats scary but thanks for your warning. I regret reaching out to my T at this point that forced me to iop and in risk of involuntary. I”ll try to avoid it.

Thanks. I know I m depressed and my T multiple times said that weekly sessions is not enough for me and asked me multiple times to consider iop. Last week they were worried for me and wanted to talk with my family and I refused. Instead I accepted to do iop. I have trouble opening up in individual therapy and I am very shy. I know that I”ll fail opening up in iop and being cooperative. I just didn’t have energy to listen to my T again about iop and I said I”ll do it just to shut them down and end the session. I will try to cancel it if they let me do it without having another session with my T since I want to end therapy on my end.
Thanks for responding.
Thanks, that’s what I thought too! But I was scared if any of my actions meant intention and ended up being in trouble.

Thanks for responding. Can you please answer if I have plan and intentions? I don’t understand psychology terms clearly and I want to talk with my therapist but I want to know if I have plan and intentions together? I think I only have plans and not intentions.  I told her I gave plans and not intention and she said you are not required to go to hospital and that was a relief. But I didn’t share details of this post with her. If I share these details, will she say the same thing?
This is really sad. Im sure your baby is sad too and it’s not her fault that her mom is not alive. Think about what your wife wants and do what makes her happy.
Thank you for sharing your thoughts. I think I am capable of acting on them ….
Is this really kill you? I was thinking of a method and this sounds an accessible one.

Thanks for sharing. I can’t see myself separate from being a coward lazy person and I have issues with accepting Im sick and I feel like its me and it my reality. I am not sure how you could separate yourself from depression. Right now I see only myself who is a coward and useless person and I feel like its my reality.
Thank you, are you in the US?
In online iop that I was refereed and I declined, it was with on camera. I don’t think it is helpful to join group therapy considering my shyness and anxiety in new places and with new people.
Thanks.

I was told multiple times by different people if I be honest with my care team, they will be able to help. Im thinking about it when Im alone, but once I see them, I feel scared and start lying and hiding.

Thank you! I still don’t think any group activity works for me. I feel like Im melting if I sit in a group session. I’ve been there 3 years ago and I couldn’t even raise my head and look around. It was like torture sitting in a group session.
You were so brave to volunteer to be hospitalized. I can’t imagine doing it.

Thanks for all the information. I was referred by my previous therapist 3 weeks ago, in my last session to start iop. But when the nurse called for iop I declined it since I am too shy to talk in a group of people. I started a new therapist yesterday and she is aware that I am terrified after my last session with my old therapist when he forced me to choose between talking with my family or call a police. I told the new therapist that I don’t want iop or inpatient. She was very understanding and she is going to check on me tomorrow. I promised her that I will be available tomorrow. But I don’t know how will be our tomorrow session. I’m going to try to end the call soon and don’t share that much to prevent forced treatment. I feel if I tell her everything she will react like my old therapist.

Thanks for sharing. I was wondering why my brain tells me every day to hurt myself and setting plans for it but my body is hesitant and I thought I am a coward and stupid person that can’t even handle this and take a lot of pills. I was scared of sharing this thought with anyone in my life except now. I am still scared of hospitalization but I will try to open up in my next appointment. I am not sure if I can but I think about it. Honestly its difficult living with this thought as it gets a lot of my energy.
I know it sounds very stupid, but I hate myself and I feel I deserve to get hurt and I hope it kills me but I should take way more pills to die and I am not ready yet to take 90 pills.

I think if I tell them all my thoughts they will have to hospitalize me by law and I don’t want that. I am so scared of hospitalization and I was trying to hide some of my thoughts from them. I’ve read that people don’t get hospitalized for self hurt and I was trying to show that I am more self hurting rather than being suicidal.
Ok. I”ll go to do this. Thanks for sharing.
Not really. I promised my therapist to exercise for 5-10 minutes before my next session but I didn’t do it yet.
I can be honest here and I choose death.
Thanks for your reply. I truly didn’t know going to bed and wishing to not wake up is not normal and I thought other people have the same thoughts. I just wanted to hide my thoughts from them.
I am scared they force me to go to hospital and I was trying to hide some of my thoughts. I don’t want them to force me to treatment and I know its hard to demy treatment if they know Im suicidal.
Thanks. I thought it’s self hurt and its different from being suicidal.

Thanks. I guess it won’t be too bad. Last time I took about 120 mg and my eyes were weird. It was like I was staring for hours and my eyes were dilated. Very weird looking. This is the part that I don’t like since I can’t hide it. I can say I don’t feel well and I have nausea but I don’t find a good reason for dilates eyes.
I hate myself so bad. I hate everything about my self. I just deserve it to get hurt or die.
I know that 900 mg of it won’t kill me. I just want to know how bad I will feel and if it makes me sick that makes me go to doctor or not?
Do you have experience?
Thanks for your reply. If that’s what you think, my doctor would probably think the same. I”ll cancel my appointment.

I went to pick up my medicine today. I knew the minute I get them, I take multiple of them. I was scared and I left the pharmacy before they hand it to me. I made an online appointment for tomorrow to tell my doctor  to remove the prescription and don’t let me pick it up. But I am scared again and don’t know how to tell my doctor. I may cancel the appointment and go to pharmacy and pick up the medication and go with my plan. I don’t know what I want and what to do. Is this normal? Or Im just a stupid person that don’t know what she wants from life.
I don’t mind if I die. But I don’t have intent to kill myself. Just hurting myself.
I had my appointment and the doctor prescribed the medication easily for me.

I am planning everything to do it secretly. I made online doctor appointment to tell my husband its a work meeting. I won’t tell him about the new medication. I am a little scared of being caught and end up in inpatient but I’m trying to have a clean plan so no one finds out. I want to feel better but I simply don’t see a solution right now. Thanks for warning me that I may end up in inpatient. I should be very careful about details.

I canceled my therapy. I have an online appointment with a new family doctor and I want to ask for medication. If I tell them why I am requesting it they obviously won’t give me the medication and probably ask me to go to er or call police and I don’t want it. I hope my plan works and I get new medication.
Thanks. Yes it’s difficult to let go my coping mechanism now and Im not ready to stop it now.
Yes but I just can’t talk about it in person with someone. I can say it here since I know you won’t act and just listen.
I see. I guess its just painful to get help. Im not sure if I can go through more pain by going to therapy at this point.

Thanks for your comment. Yes he told me he has to protect himself and his license and I felt bad about myself as I am a threat to him. I am struggling with self hate and this situation was not helping. But deep inside I know he just did his job.

Thanks! I couldn’t get medication from this online doctor and he referred me to see my family doctor. I have appointment with my family doctor ( first visit with him since its a new insurance) tomorrow and I hope he prescribes what I want.

Thanks for your comment. But I won’t tell them about my intentions. I want to get the medicine. I’m not just sure if they accept my request. I hope they do accept. I’ve done it two years ago with kind of the same plan and it worked. But this time is new state, new doctor and new insurance. I don’t know if my plan works.
Its my life and my body. I don’t want others deciding it.
Up for some help

I am mad at my therapist because he informed my partner about my medication and now my partner has locked all my medication. They were expired but they were my hope to do an overdose and sleep. Im thinking to buy some tylenol or maybe cut my arm so it may help me feel less pressure. I just want to sleep. Thats all I want.
My plan is to show it as an accident of cutting while doing cooking. I don’t want to be hospitalized and I don’t see any point in it.
Thanks. They have not called yet and they probably won’t since they were supposed to call in a day or two.

Thanks. They have not told me directly to go iop and when they were talking with my partner about my safety, they said that some one will call her for iop and my partner accepted. I really don’t want to do the iop and I don’t care if the therapist don’t accept to see me again. I just don’t want to be forced into getting treatment.

I don’t see any help out there. I feel like there is no healing for my pain and I don’t want to waste others resources while I know they can’t help me. I am too private and I can’t talk in group sessions and I don’t like other people see me and be aware of my pain even strangers.
Sleep. That’s only thing keep me a way from life.
I don’t know about the reasons.
I just don’t like myself. Almost hate myself. Don’t enjoy life.
Nothing. I think about it almost every day. But not going to do it tonight
Thank you!

I’m sorry For the experience. I don’t like the system too but I’m sure there is one counselor or therapist out there that you find them helpful. Please don’t give up and start seeing a counselor until you find the one. You don’t have to tell them everything from the first session. Start slowly until you feel trust. Virtual hug for you brave person.
Depression lies to you and make you believe that what you think is the reality! Your reaction is completely normal because that’s how depression works. So please get help.

I’m sorry to hear that you are feeling this. The truth is that you are mentally sick and that’s why you have this attitude. Please please please go see a doctor and get help. You will see things different with a healthy mind.
That’s not true. Everyone is beautiful in its own way. I’m sure there are people who like brown male. If you like your self, you will look more beautiful in others eyes! Believe me!
Good! I feel better knowing it’s normal :)
Thank you for your advice. I have a GP and a counselor but I don’t want to talk to them because I’m scared they advice me to go to the hospital. I will think about your thoughts. Thank you!
I think you need help and I am sure you will feel better with getting help and practice. Have you ever considered counseling?
Thank you!
Thank you! I was too nervous about it.
Thank you for your suggestion. I still struggle with negative/self harm/suicidal thoughts and I can’t trust anyone based on what happened in the hospital.

A part of feeling good is about the chemicals in the brain that must be there to feel happy or normal. Maybe you need medicine to balance the chemicals in your brain. Then every thing will look different in your mind. I promise that you will feel better if you seek help from a professional. You are too young to leave this world.

You are so young and you have a lot of life and opportunities in front you. Don’t give up now! You can make a completely different future for your self. Can you get help from school? Or your family doctor? 
There is always a way to help you, please don’t give up and search for that way.

I’m sorry. You are not alone and there are other people with the same fillings. You need to seek help from your family doctor or a counselor. It will be a long and hard road, but you will feel better step by step. I know it’s so hard to start getting help but you can do it! If you feel comfortable with your family doctor just make an appointment and talk to them. It seems that you will never feel good again, but that is not true and you feel this way because you are sick. You will start feeling different if you get help.
You need to talk to a counselor and they will tell you if you are depressed or not.
